title: ID0431515-DC/Si-D/PK- [MP / P3 170000287] loose DC cable connection from its DC Nozzle
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
One DC fast charging ports has developed a connectivity issue due
to a loose DC cable connection from its DC Nozzle. As a
precautionary measure, we have temporarily disabled that specific
charging port to avoid any safety hazards or potential equipment
damage. Resolution of the issue is required from Siemens to
restore the affected charging port as well

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431515-DC/Si-D/PK- [MP / P3 170000287] Connectivity issue CRM:02832000075
additional_info.body:
Hi Adnan Khan,
I hope you're doing well.
We are handing over the case to the RC queue for further proceeding.
Upon checking on SCB, we observed that both DC outlets are currently active, indicating that the outlet with the loose DC cable connection has not yet been disabled. For safety reasons, we strongly advise to disabling the outlet until a thorough inspection is completed. There is a significant risk of a short circuit, which could result in a high current surge and potentially cause further damage to the charger.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

Dear Mr. Sadek,
We are facing almost same issue of charging cable with charger installed in Karachi. And as per my recent interventions with the support team this charging cable is not repairable. Normally support advice to replace the cable in case of any issue/fault. Would you please clarify what can we achieve with site intervention and please advise for below points.
Can we repair it at site?  if yes please send the procedure to repair.
If it is not repairable then please share the quotation for cable with delivery time.
If it known quality issue, then it should be replaced free of cost.
Waiting for your response on above points.
As per my opinion it will be better to send the stop instruction to customer with the solution and timelines.
Regards,
Adnan Khan
